name: Demo Selenium Python for Google Search
summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in Python, teaching locator strategies and assertions for a Google Search results page. Must never be executed against live google.com.
description: This repo demonstrates Selenium WebDriver browser automation testing with Python, using a Google Search results page as the example. Because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of Google Search, the code teaches patterns only: the home page title check, the search box locator and query submission, and the first-result click, all as correct but never-to-be-run Python/Selenium code.
